proposition_variant: Contemporaneous report: 1970s cooling would damage food production
source_document: The Cooling World (original article; archival reproduction)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Authorship and printed 1975 date attributed to Gwynne/Newsweek. This is an original media article but not a scientific literature census or present-day temperature trend.

proposition_variant: Original 1975 author repudiates modern use of cooling article
source_document: Stop Citing My 1975 Global Cooling Article (first-person author reassessment as reprinted)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: First-person Gwynne retrospective explicitly identifies his own 1975 article and says contemporary warming not cooling. Reprint is not a second independent original cooling study.

proposition_variant: 1970s cooling scientific consensus allegation tested against period literature
original_author_or_institution: Thomas C Peterson; William M Connolley; John Fleck
source_document: The Myth of the 1970s Global Cooling Scientific Consensus (BAMS original paper)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Researchers report 7 cooling 20 neutral 44 warming-oriented papers from 1965-79 under their retrieval/classification; not all 1970s climate scientists universally surveyed.

proposition_variant: Original specialist 2008 response to claim global warming stopped or reversed in 1998
original_author_or_institution: Robert Fawcett; David Jones; Australian Bureau of Meteorology
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Authors distinguish a short 1998-start window from global long-run trend and 1997-98 El Nino effects; does not name first-ever author of cooling-since-1998 slogan.

proposition_variant: Short cooling runs may occur amid long-term greenhouse warming
original_author_or_institution: David R Easterling; Michael F Wehner
source_document: Is the climate warming or cooling? (GRL original peer-reviewed paper)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Physical short-term cool/flat intervals and secular warming can coexist; not a denial claim origin or physical observation of current long-run cooling.

proposition_variant: NASA 2025 update: 2025 less warm than 2024 but continuing long-run warming
original_author_or_institution: NASA GISS; NASA original annual release
source_document: NASA Releases Global Temperature Data (annual 2025 report)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: NASA says 2024 hottest annual year; 2025 cooler than 2024 but roughly tied with 2023. One down-year is not multi-decadal cooling; global datasets share some observations.

original_author_or_institution: Institute of Biospheric Research; Sherwood Idso; Western Fuels Association (reported funder)
source_document: The Greening of Planet Earth (1992 original film; archival description and original linked)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Climate Files identifies producer Institute of Biospheric Research and funder Western Fuels Association, with Sherwood Idso featured. Original full moving picture not inspected in this cut; archival commentary is not itself a paid invoice.

proposition_variant: Greening Earth Society sequel extends 1992 promotional framing
original_author_or_institution: Greening Earth Society; Western Fuels Association
source_document: The Greening of Planet Earth Continues (archived film transcript)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Archival index says 1998 follow-up to 1992 film, not an independent set of controlled photosynthesis experiments. Direct film/transcript contents and funding receipts not newly inspected.

proposition_variant: 1998 mail petition benefits claim and no anthropogenic catastrophic harm claim
original_author_or_institution: Arthur B Robinson; Oregon Institute of Science and Medicine; Frederick Seitz covering letter
source_document: Global Warming Petition Project original petition letter (current public reproduction)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: OISM first-party gives original Kyoto petition and Seitz letter. Website now claims 31000+ accumulated signers, not verified 1998 number nor independently audited climate expert credentials. Campaign funding denial is the organisation's self-report.

proposition_variant: 1998 enclosed scientific-looking manuscript asserted climate harms absent and CO2 greening beneficial
original_author_or_institution: Arthur B Robinson; Sallie Baliunas; Willie Soon; Zachary W Robinson
source_document: Environmental Effects of Increased Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide (January 1998 copy)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Original copy identifies four authors. A circulated manuscript is not proof of National Academy publication or climate model validation; PDF located at third-party archive, not its originating publisher.

proposition_variant: Academy institution explicitly rejects affiliation with 1998 petition and pseudo-PNAS manuscript
original_author_or_institution: Council of the US National Academy of Sciences
source_document: Statement of the Council of the NAS Regarding Global Change Petition
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: NAS specifically says petition has nothing to do with NAS and manuscript was not published by PNAS or another peer-reviewed journal at that time. This does not prove nobody signed the petition.

proposition_variant: 1999 review reprises environmental CO2 benefit and no-harm proposition
original_author_or_institution: Willie Soon; Sallie L Baliunas; Arthur B Robinson; Zachary W Robinson
source_document: Environmental Effects of Increased Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide (Energy & Environment 10)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Journal publication exists 1999 and is not the 1998 Academy-affiliated paper. Full text restricted; treat as later author work in same topical/work lineage, exact version diff and peer review details remain to verify.

proposition_variant: Modern institutional literal slogan CO2 is plant food plus many claimed benefits
source_document: Fact #1: First and foremost CO2 is plant food
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Publisher first-party claim supported by its selection of NASA greening references. Undated live page cannot be backdated to 1992 or 2015; identical topic does not prove WFA-to-Coalition funding or copied script.

proposition_variant: Named original author repeats plant food and net-positive framing
source_document: Life-Giving CO2 Should Be Valued Not Demonized
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: An authored essay and institution fact page share position; they are two publication surfaces not scientific confirmations. Author credit belongs to Jayaraj, not automatically to institution founder.

proposition_variant: Observed global vegetation greening and estimated CO2 contribution
source_document: Greening of the Earth and its drivers (Nature Climate Change original study)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Original paper reports 25-50% vegetated area greening and ~70% of its observed greening trend associated with CO2 fertilization in model attribution; not a figure for global net welfare or climate harmlessness.

proposition_variant: Fertilization response varies by mycorrhizal and nitrogen context
source_document: Mycorrhizal association as a primary control of the CO2 fertilization effect (Science)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Global experimental synthesis identifies species-group and soil nitrogen constraints. It does not imply all species fail to respond, nor that fertilization means net climate benefit.

proposition_variant: Global biomass growth response constrained by N and P
source_document: Nitrogen and phosphorus constrain CO2 fertilization of global plant biomass
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Original analysis of 138 experiments reports nutrient constraints. Shares lead author with 2016 Science synthesis, so do not count as fully independent producer institutions without an author/project dependency check.

proposition_variant: Five parent claim types with subclaims and subsubclaims
original_author_or_institution: Travis G Coan; Constantine Boussalis; John Cook; Mirjam O Nanko
source_document: Computer-assisted classification of contrarian claims about climate change (Scientific Reports 2021)
attribution_and_nonpromotion_boundary: Original original claim taxonomy built from selected think-tank and blog texts, with five top-level claim types; not a census of all global claims or direct proof that quoted arguments are scientifically true or false.
